reviews.text: i genuinely love these a lot! they taste so good, & i e noticed that they help me use the restroom more often. i do notice sometimes that if i don’t drink them for awhile and im eating a lot of junk food, & then drink one afterwards, ill end up running to the bathroom😅😂. these def help w my digestion. i love these as an alternative for soda :)
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢啲！佢哋好好味，而且我留意到佢哋幫我多啲去廁所。我有時會留意到，如果我好耐冇飲，然後食咗好多垃圾食物，再飲一支嘅時候，我就會跑去廁所😅😂。呢啲真係幫我消化。我鍾意將佢哋當做汽水嘅替代品 :)

reviews.text: mixes extremely well. i tried the apple flavor very good with simple cold water but i like it best with carbonated water if i have access. i let my friends try it some say its too sweet, most agree with me that it is just right
reviews.zh: 溶得非常好。我試過蘋果味，用簡單嘅冷水沖，都好好飲，不過如果有汽水，我就最鍾意用汽水沖。我俾我朋友試過，有啲人話太甜，但係大部分人都同意我，話甜度啱啱好。

reviews.text: the taste of passion fruit find it quite natural, the digestion and the relief from bloat is instant; no sugar no spikes so helped me loose those couples kilos from extra sugar , best alternative to soda !!!!
reviews.zh: 百香果嘅味道，我覺得好天然。消化同脹氣嘅舒緩係即時嘅；冇糖、冇血糖飆升，所以幫我減咗幾公斤因為額外糖分而增加嘅體重，係最好嘅汽水替代品！！！！

reviews.text:
I really like this product (and this type of drinks), it makes it really easy to drink more water during the day (something I generally struggle with).
It is easy to make, just add it to water and shake it (a bottle is more convenient than a glass).
As for this specific Flavour, I have never tried the actual grape type but I have tried other drinks and foods with the Flavour and it is the same. I do not like grapes that much but I still like this.
reviews.zh:
我真係好鍾意呢款產品（同呢類飲品），令我每日飲多啲水變得容易得多（呢方面我一般都好辛苦）。
好易整，只需要加入水入面再搖勻（用樽比用杯更方便）。
至於呢個口味，我從來未試過真正嘅提子味，但係我試過其他飲品同食物有同樣嘅味道，而且係一樣嘅。我唔太鍾意提子，但係我仍然鍾意呢款。

reviews.text: It is yummy however I felt dehydrated a while after drinking this product. Drink plenty of water Through the day. I have had no bade digestive reaction to it. Noticed that it has curbed my appetite too where i am now unable to finish a full meal.
reviews.zh: 好味。不過我飲咗之後，過咗一陣子就覺得有啲脫水，要整日多飲水。我嘅消化冇咩負面反應。我留意到佢都抑制咗我嘅食慾，而家我已經食唔晒一餐。

reviews.text: It has a delicious and fruity taste. Since I have been consuming it I noticed that my hunger has been curbed and I don't have much appetite, even though I am not trying to diet. It has not affected my digestion in any negative way.
reviews.zh: 味道美味，有果香。自從我開始飲，我留意到我嘅飢餓感減咗，食慾都唔多，但係我又唔係為咗減肥。佢對我嘅消化冇任何負面影響。

reviews.text: I really love these korean pouch kombucha. very refreshing during summer and it is suger free which is always a plus. i can't say that my digestion is improving from the kombucha but I enjoy the taste no matter that. I will try other flavours.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款韓國袋裝康普茶。夏天飲好清涼，而且無糖一直都係好嘢。我唔可以話我嘅消化有改善，但係我鍾意佢嘅味道，無論如何都係咁。我會試吓其他口味。
